scope: Inactive reference arithmetic, paired action contracts, review adapter; no public routes
added_steps:
- name: Generate inactive HYB1 reference and hybrid review PDFs
        run: python ../scripts/generate_hyb1_ci_pdfs.py --output hyb1-review-pdfs
      - name: Upload inactive HYB1 review evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: hyb1-pdfs-${{ matrix.os }}
          path: backend/hyb1-review-pdfs/
          if-no-files-found: error
